description.en: A co-op puzzle platformer for DeepSeek Harness: you play one hero in the dsh web side bar, the agent plays the other.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的双人解谜平台游戏：你在 dsh web 右侧栏控一个角色，Agent 控另一个。

title.zh: 双联画：和 Agent 一起玩

description.en: Fire and ice: a two-player puzzle platformer in the dsh web side bar. You play one hero with the keyboard; the agent plays the other through its tools, talks to you, and waits on the button while you cross.
description.zh: 火与冰的双人解谜平台游戏：你用键盘控一个角色，Agent 通过工具控另一个，会说话、会等你，踩住按钮让你过去。
